summary: Warhorse Studios' historically grounded first-person RPG series, with PC complete editions as the highest-fidelity routes and console/Switch/cloud ports documented separately.

entries.title: Kingdom Come: Deliverance

emulation.notes: Use the native PC Royal Edition with current patches.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC output; current-generation console versions are the console fallback.

primary.version: Kingdom Come: Deliverance Royal Edition PC release
primary.why: The Windows Royal Edition includes the base game and all DLC, and PC remains the highest-fidelity capture route. Later PS5/Xbox Series versions are strong enhanced console routes, while Switch is a portability-focused port.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows Royal Edition or equivalent complete PC bundle with current patches and graphics settings; use console enhanced versions only if a console capture route is preferred.

entries.remaster_caveats: Current-generation console releases improve fidelity/performance but do not add story DLC beyond the Royal Edition content set.

entries.title: Kingdom Come: Deliverance II

emulation.notes: Use the native PC Royal Edition with current patches.

primary.version: Kingdom Come: Deliverance II Royal Edition PC release
primary.why: The Royal Edition bundles the base game with the post-launch DLC set, while Windows is the highest-fidelity and most configurable capture route for this current-generation-only sequel.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows Royal Edition or equivalent complete PC bundle through Steam/Epic/GOG, with current patches and graphics settings.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster is documented; Royal Edition supersedes the earlier Gold Edition naming/content bundle after the DLC roadmap.
